title: Covariate-Adaptive Studentized Sensitivity Analysis for Neyman’s Weak Null in Matched Designs
imageAlt: A matched-set schematic with I sets of varying sizes, each containing one treated unit and the remaining control units.
abstract: Develops covariate-adaptive sensitivity analysis for the sample-average treatment effect in matched observational studies. A closed-form lower-envelope statistic and studentization support asymptotically valid tests of Neyman’s weak null while allowing heterogeneous effects and unequal treatment probabilities within matched sets.
citation: Qi Huang, Pengyun Wang, Xinran Li. Covariate-Adaptive Studentized Sensitivity Analysis for Neyman’s Weak Null in Matched Designs. Working paper.

title: Stronger Artificial Intelligence Breakthroughs Hasten Their Own Exhaustion
imageAlt: Six panels show the idea life cycle, new and dead idea shares, AlexNet and Transformer citation patterns, successive active-idea cycles, and simulated effects of reciprocal reviewing.
abstract: Examines how major AI breakthroughs concentrate scientific attention and are followed by faster exhaustion of ideas. Analyses of publications and peer reviews, together with agent-based simulations, connect this pattern to declining diversity and the effects of reciprocal reviewing.
citation: Beichen Lu, Honglin Bao, Qi Huang, Qingguo Meng, James A. Evans. Stronger Artificial Intelligence Breakthroughs Hasten Their Own Exhaustion. Nature Machine Intelligence. Submitted.

title: QEGF: A Quantum-Inspired Geometric and Energy-Based Fusion Framework for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
imageAlt: QEGF architecture showing audio, text and video encoding, quantum-inspired geometric fusion, a task-adaptive transformer, energy-based uncertainty modeling, and uncertainty-guided prediction.
abstract: Combines geometric multimodal fusion with energy-based uncertainty modeling for sentiment analysis. Trace-normalized symmetric positive-definite descriptors model second-order correlations, while task-adaptive refinement and uncertainty estimates support robust predictions.
citation: Yuxuan Hu, Yushan Pan, Minghui Zhu, Xiaojiang He, Nan Xiang, Qi Huang, Ruizhi Ning, Yanlong Cao, Zhijie Xu. QEGF: A Quantum-Inspired Geometric and Energy-Based Fusion Framework for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis. TPAMI. Early Access · 2026.

title: A Comprehensive Graph Pooling Benchmark: Effectiveness, Robustness and Generalizability
imageAlt: Graph-pooling benchmark backbone: message passing transforms the input graph, pooling reduces it, and readout produces a graph-level feature for supervised prediction.
abstract: Benchmarks 17 graph pooling methods across 28 datasets under shared experimental settings. Evaluates effectiveness, robustness to perturbations and distribution shifts, generalizability, and computational efficiency.
citation: Pengyun Wang, Junyu Luo, Yanxin Shen, Ming Zhang, Shaoen Qin, Hanwen Xing, Siyu Heng, Qi Huang, Xiao Luo. A Comprehensive Graph Pooling Benchmark: Effectiveness, Robustness and Generalizability. TKDD. Major revision.

title: PVI-DPO: Perceptual Video Inpainting via Informative-Safe Preference Mining and Region-Aware Direct Preference Optimization
imageAlt: Two rows of video-inpainting comparisons show a bus and a mountain scene, with masked inputs, baseline reconstructions, and PVI-DPO results; boxes mark boundaries and structural details.
abstract: Learns video-inpainting preferences by contrasting ground-truth clips with carefully selected model failures localized to the masked region. A region-aware, winner-safe DPO objective emphasizes masked regions and boundaries while protecting the preferred reconstruction.
citation: Jia Huang, Hongyou Zhou, Qi Huang, Hongbin Liu, Peng Zhang, Zhengqi Sun, Lumin Xu. PVI-DPO: Perceptual Video Inpainting via Informative-Safe Preference Mining and Region-Aware Direct Preference Optimization. AAAI 2027. Submitted.

title: Half-routing Consistency Guidance with Batch-aware Gating for Audio-Visual Test-Time Adaptation
imageAlt: HEART pipeline: audio and visual inputs provide an anchor pseudo-label; complementary half-routes assess support; batch coverage and contrast set a gate that weights adaptation and permits a Self-Anchor fallback.
abstract: Checks anchor pseudo-label reliability through complementary audio–visual half-routes. Batch support coverage and contrast control the adaptation weight, with a Self-Anchor fallback when route evidence is uninformative.
citation: Qi Huang, Xiao Luo. Half-routing Consistency Guidance with Batch-aware Gating for Audio-Visual Test-Time Adaptation. HEART. Manuscript.
